classification.difficultyReason: Students identify removed cross-sections, reconstruct dimensions using shoulders and diameters, and subtract component volumes; the mixed-unit tube also requires consistent units before calculation.

content.prompt: Calculate the volume of these solids. If units are not shown, they are in cm. Round to 1 d.p.

spec.description: Horizontal hollow cylinder. Separate front radius leaders identify inner radius 8 and outer radius 12; length 20 is dimensioned below.
spec.mathematics: Outer radius 12 cm, inner radius 8 cm, length 20 cm.

spec.description: Upright square prism with cylindrical through-hole. Four equal-edge ticks on the top square, two adjacent 10 labels and height 40. Hole boundaries below the top are dashed.
spec.mathematics: Square side 10 cm, height 40 cm, cylindrical hole radius 4 cm.

spec.description: Hollow semicylinder with consecutive front dimensions 5, 10, 5 and longitudinal length 45.
spec.mathematics: Outer radius 10 cm, inner radius 5 cm, length 45 cm.

spec.description: Rectangular prism with triangular channel along its depth. The 8 and 6 channel sides meet at a right angle; exterior dimensions 36, 15 and 25.
spec.mathematics: Removed right-triangular cross-section area is one half of 8 times 6; depth 25 cm.

spec.description: Rectangular prism with semicylindrical bottom channel. Radius arrow 4, equal bottom shoulders with left shoulder labelled 5, height 11 and depth 7.
spec.mathematics: Width 5+8+5=18 cm; removed semicircle radius 4 cm; extrusion depth 7 cm.

answer.worked:
The matching ticks give equal $5\text{ cm}$ shoulders.
$$\begin{align*}w&=5+2\times4+5\\w&=18\text{ cm}\\V_1&=18\times11\times7\\V_1&=1386\text{ cm}^3\\V_2&=\frac{\pi\times4^2}{2}\times7\\V_2&=56\pi\text{ cm}^3\\V&=1386-56\pi\\V&\approx1210.1\text{ cm}^3\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Oblique hollow cylinder, inner diameter arrow identified by an external 108 cm leader, outer diameter 2 m and length 4 m. Decorative annular shading omitted.
spec.mathematics: Outer radius 1 m, inner radius 0.54 m, length 4 m.
